scope: Source contract crosswalk, not semantic model accuracy or whole-group acceptance

SPECIFIC_SEARCH.boundary: Current catalog evidence and hard constraints, no transaction

BROAD_DISCOVERY.boundary: Literal category or clarification, never inferred recipient tastes

COMPARISON.boundary: Per-target source evidence or catalog fallback; missing coverage explicit

PRICE_INQUIRY.boundary: Listed price/currency only; no invented discount or policy

SPECS_INQUIRY.boundary: Source quotes and independent exact-product review; entailment not certified

CART_ACTION.boundary: Explicit current request, owner-bound review/navigation, never inferred execution

OUT_OF_DOMAIN.boundary: Brief greeting differs from unrelated substantive request

ECOSYSTEM_BUILDER.boundary: Reviewed component planning/scope/budget; no unsupported complete-compatible system claim

NEGOTIATION.boundary: Acknowledge explicit concession request, never authorize discount or commitment

OBJECTION.boundary: Exact current concern and honest unknowns, no inferred wealth/personality or pressure

fields.target_products: Literal SearchTarget array; maximum3, ambiguity clarifies instead of truncating an essential target
fields.detected_occasion: ShoppingBrief occasion, grounded in customer text
fields.sentiment: Five original labels restored as tone-only metadata, requiring exact current sentiment_evidence; ungrounded becomes neutral. No hidden personality/financial or urgency fact.
fields.competitor_mentioned: Literal current customer name preserved as unverified task context, never competitor-price/stock proof or suppression authority.
fields.budget_max: Grounded decimal budget plus explicit currency; no conversion or assumed currency
fields.required_features: Literal shared or independently reviewed per-target positive/negative constraints
fields.cart_action_type: Typed ordinary cart intents require explicit request and customer review
fields.is_jailbreak_attempt: Untrusted input boundaries, not a classifier boolean trusted to grant authority
fields.suggested_pivot: No unreviewed model pivot is product evidence or permission

intentional_exclusions: Hidden financial/personality inference as sales authority
Fabricated urgency, popularity, stock or discounts
Model-selected transactions without explicit owner review
Unreviewed legacy prose as a current offer
still_open: Owner deployment and real provider receipts
